units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 92:13">Targ. Ps. XCII, 13</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 22:3">Targ. Y. Gen. XXII, 3</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 59a:18">B. Kam. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>ד׳ ארמאה</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>דארמ׳</he>, incorr.) an Aramean palm, <he>ד׳ פרסאה</he> a Persian palm.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 92b:12">Ib. 92ᵇ</cite> (prov.) <he>מטייל ואזיל ד׳ וכ׳</he> the bad palm will travel to meet a barren cane (like meets like).
<cite ref="Berakhot 55b:21">Ber. 55ᵇ</cite> bot. none see in a dream <he>ד׳ דדהבא</he> a golden palm-tree (a thing not experienced in reality).
<cite ref="Eruvin 51a:3">Erub. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>ד׳ דסביל וכ׳</he> a palm-tree which supports its neighbor.
<cite ref="Eruvin 51a:3">Ib.</cite> <he>ד׳ דפריק וכ׳</he> a palm which pays its owner’s taxes.

<cite ref="Ketubot 10b:14">Keth. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>כי נרגא לדיקלא</he> (not <he>לדיקולא</he>) as injurious as the axe to the palm-tree.—Pl. <he>דִּקְלִין</he>, <he>דִּקְלַיָּא</he>, <cite ref="D01011"><he>דִּקְלֵי</he></cite>, <cite ref="D00763"><he>דִּי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 2:2:4">Y. R. Hash. II, 58ᵃ</cite> top, a. e. <he>ד׳ דבבל</he> the Babylonian palms.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 26a:11">B. Bath. 26ᵃ</cite>; a. fr. [<cite ref="Shabbat 110a:6">Sabb. 110ᵃ</cite> <he>שני דקלי</he>, read: <he>דקלים</he> as Ms. M.]—Fem. form <he>דִּיקְלָתָא</he>. Sabb. l. c. <he>תרתי ד׳</he> Ms. O. (ed. <cite ref="V00569"><he>תלאי</he></cite>, Ms. M. <cite ref="V00453"><he>תילתא</he></cite>, corr. acc.), v. Y. ib. XIV, 14ᶜ
